item.title: [Tamil] [OTT Release] Enemy Of The Smuggler
item.description:
Source91Mobiles OTT
LanguageTamil
CategoryOTT Release
Release Date27 Nov 2026 (OTT)

The film's plot follows two young men from the slums of Chennai who work with a Customs officer. Their lives take a dramatic turn when they team up with a notorious smuggler for a significant assignment, which involves clearing a drug consignment through a port in Gujarat. They soon find themselves entangled in an intricate network of organised crime, involving bribery and betrayal.
